title: Quality Control and Standardization of Herbals

syllabusSource.title: Pharmacy Council of India B.Pharm syllabus (as published by Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya), BP806ET Quality Control and Standardization of Herbals (elective)

units.title: Basic tests, WHO guidelines for quality control and evaluation of crude drugs
Quality assurance in the herbal industry: GAP, GACP, GMP, cGMP and GLP
EU and ICH guidelines and research guidelines for safety and efficacy
Stability testing, chromatographic standardisation, dossiers and Drugs and Cosmetics Act
Regulatory requirements, pharmacovigilance, herbal pharmacopoeias and markers
